messages:
eva: quick sync — we have three competing asks for next catalog wave: 1) Llama-3 70B fine-tune for higher-quality embeddings (customer X/enterprise sales), 2) Mistral-Chat 8B optimized for 95p latency, 3) smaller cheap embed model for self-serve. need sequencing + launch criteria.
priya: +1 — sales team is pushing Llama-3 fine-tune, claims 4 deals in the pipeline that hinge on vector quality. shows high ARR upside but bigger infra/ops cost.
marco: from an ML perspective: Llama-3 70B will need 80+GB RAM (FP16) unless we quantize aggressively. quantization reduces perf risk but changes embedding numerics. needs eval on embedding drift.
sam: infra note: if we onboard 70B as-hosted, we need to reserve Dedicated slots or fallback to a quantized variant. latency SLOs will be hard to meet at <300ms 95p without vLLM/kernel tweaks.
olivia: from customer-facing side — customers asking for better semantic search right now. they’d accept a staged approach: embeddings-first (API + migration docs) then full chat model later. that aligns with revenue risk reduction. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
catalog-bot: catalog telemetry: top 20 enterprise projects show embedding usage growth +42% q/q; average similarity threshold tuning requests up 18%.
eva: thinking RICE to decide order. proposed quick calc:
```
reach = 120 enterprise customers likely to convert
impact = 3 (large revenue upside)
confidence = 0.6
effort = 8 (infra + eval + fine-tune ops)
score = (120*3*0.6)/8 = 27
```
priya: compare to Mistral-chat (low effort, impact medium):
```
reach = 400 self-serve + 50 enterprise
impact = 1.5
confidence = 0.8
effort = 3
score = (450*1.5*0.8)/3 = 180
```
marco: those numbers show Mistral chat scores high because reach is broad. but business care about ARR per deal; we should add a revenue multiplier or run a separate ARR-weighted RICE.
sam: operational cost estimate: Llama-3 70B fine-tune + hosted variant ~ $Xk/month baseline, Mistral-chat ~ 20% of that. if we can do embeddings-first for Llama-3 as a managed finetune artifact (host embeddings only) we reduce serving complexity.
eva: launch criteria proposal (per-model):
- embeddings: L2/rocAUC regression vs baseline pass threshold (>= +3% or p<0.05)
- 95p latency under target: embeddings < 200ms, chat < 300ms for committed tier
- fallback variant available (quantized) with documented drift tolerance
- pricing sketch and Dedicated sizing + observability dashboards ready
priya: scope negotiation: we can ship Llama-3 embeddings first (significant revenue signal) and hold full chat until we have quantized kernels validated. that splits effort and shortens time-to-revenue.
marco: agree. plan for a controlled rollout: canary on Dedicated for top 5 customers, A/B compare embedding quality and downstream search metrics.
sam: ops plan: reserve 2 nodes for canary week, enable automatic fallback to Llama-3-quant if latency spikes, add per-route cost tags.
olivia: sales playbook: offer migration credits for customers who trial embeddings during canary; collect scoring logs and qualitative feedback.
eva: decision checklist:
- Product: embeddings-first for Llama-3 (yes)
- Eng: validate quantized fallback in parallel (ok)
- Sales: prioritize 3 pilot customers (olivia to own)
- Metrics: define success signals (search CTR, recall lift, trial->paid rate)
any objections?
priya: no objections. request: capture ARR-weighted RICE separately and keep it in the intake doc.
marco: I'll start an eval run and post results here by EOD Friday. will include embedding drift matrix + perf counters.
sam: i'll scope Dedicated reserve and cost estimate by Wed.
olivia: reaching out to pilots now — will update pipeline doc. :rocket:
